dedupe_keys.name: haut debit calendrier de fermeture du reseau cuivre

description: Haut Débit : Calendrier de fermeture du réseau cuivre is a dataset listed in data.corsica open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Collectivité de Corse. Le jeu de données “fermeture réseau cuivre” est publié sur le portail du ministère de l’Économie Il s’appuie sur les trajectoires prévues par Orange pour la fermeture progressive du réseau cuivre en France, et permet de visualiser les dates de fermeture prévues à l’échelle communale, départementale ou régionale. Coverage: Corsica. The portal files it under Digital and Telecommunications. Its keywords are HAUT DEBIT, Cuivre, numerique, DTAN, ambizione digitale. The portal shows 376 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2025-10-17 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-www-data-corsica-portal.
